title: Tunisian Cauliflower Shawarma
description: A flavorful and healthy twist on traditional shawarma, featuring grilled cauliflower, kissed with a hint of char.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together tunisian spice blend and grill oil.
Brush the mixture on both sides of the cauliflower.
Grill the cauliflower for 5-7 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
Let the cauliflower rest for 2-3 minutes before slicing into thin strips.
Warm pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it on the grill for 2-3 minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by placing a few slices of cauliflower onto each pita, drizzling with lemon juice and sprinkling with garlic.
